structured_output.summary: The diff implements the get SharedArrayBuffer.prototype.maxByteLength steps in order. Step 2 (RequireInternalSlot) throws a TypeError for non-objects and objects without [[ArrayBufferData]]. Step 3 (IsSharedArrayBuffer) throws a TypeError for plain ArrayBuffers. Steps 4-6 return the byte length when there is no max length and the max length otherwise, converted with `as f64`. No test-specific branches, hardcoded values, swallowed errors, or fallback defaults. Renaming the unused `args`/`new_target` parameters to `_args`/`_new_target` is harmless. I could not inspect the helper modules, so I rely on the gate result and on `max_byte_length` being Some exactly when the [[ArrayBufferMaxByteLength]] slot exists.
